g.text: POWER INPUT 12-24V (J6) / reverse polarity + transient protection

g.desc: POWER INPUT 12-24V (J6) / reverse polarity + transient protection

g.text: CLIM1/BOOST/FLIM pull-ups must use DRV_VCC, never +3V3_D.

g.desc: CLIM1/BOOST/FLIM pull-ups must use DRV_VCC, never +3V3_D.

g.text: Fit one set of pull-ups on the bus.

g.desc: Fit one set of pull-ups on the bus.

g.text: VM capacitors: C15 bulk 220uF/63V; C16 at VMA; C17 at VMB; C18 10uF/50V.

g.desc: VM capacitors: C15 bulk 220uF/63V; C16 at VMA; C17 at VMB; C18 10uF/50V.

g.text: Keep VM-PGND loops short; paired pins joined at IC on PCB.

g.desc: Keep VM-PGND loops short; paired pins joined at IC on PCB.

g.text: Firmware: DAC1_OUT1 PA4 buffer enabled; reference VDDA/VREF+ (+3V3_A).

g.desc: Firmware: DAC1_OUT1 PA4 buffer enabled; reference VDDA/VREF+ (+3V3_A).

g.text: Buffered DAC may retain ~0.2V: ENABLE Low or disable DAC for zero current.

g.desc: Buffered DAC may retain ~0.2V: ENABLE Low or disable DAC for zero current.

g.text: Startup: check VM -> set DAC -> set DMODE -> wait >=7.5us -> ENABLE High.

g.desc: Startup: check VM -> set DAC -> set DMODE -> wait >=7.5us -> ENABLE High.

g.text: Reset: ENABLE/DMODE/AGC Low; evaluate initially with AGC0=AGC1=Low.

g.desc: Reset: ENABLE/DMODE/AGC Low; evaluate initially with AGC0=AGC1=Low.

g.text: VREF: R29=10k series, R30=9.1k to GND, C21=100nF.

g.desc: VREF: R29=10k series, R30=9.1k to GND, C21=100nF.

g.text: R30/C21 GND return near pins29/30, away from OUT/VM.

g.desc: R30/C21 GND return near pins29/30, away from OUT/VM.

g.text: Place close to pin35. DRV_VCC: internal 5V, setting circuits only.

g.desc: Place close to pin35. DRV_VCC: internal 5V, setting circuits only.

g.text: VTref: target voltage sense, no debugger power injection.

g.desc: VTref: target voltage sense, no debugger power injection.

g.text: PA9: GPIO VBUS detect; enable USB only with VBUS.

g.desc: PA9: GPIO VBUS detect; enable USB only with VBUS.

g.text: Internal D+ pull-up / termination. 90-ohm differential PCB pair.

g.desc: Internal D+ pull-up / termination. 90-ohm differential PCB pair.

g.text: TERM: POPULATE AT BUS ENDS ONLY

g.desc: TERM: POPULATE AT BUS ENDS ONLY

g.text: MCU: internal HSI/MSI; USB HSI48 + CRS/SOF.

g.desc: MCU: internal HSI/MSI; USB HSI48 + CRS/SOF.

g.text: PH0/PH1: no external HSE. PC14/PC15 are GPIO, no LSE.

g.desc: PH0/PH1: no external HSE. PC14/PC15 are GPIO, no LSE.

g.text: BOOT0 = PH3 pin44 (PB8_BOOT); PB8 pin45 = DRV_AGC0.

g.desc: BOOT0 = PH3 pin44 (PB8_BOOT); PB8 pin45 = DRV_AGC0.

g.text: VDDA/VREF+ share pin9; disable VREFBUF output.

g.desc: VDDA/VREF+ share pin9; disable VREFBUF output.

g.text: C38: VBAT 100nF; C39: VDDA 10nF; C40: VDDUSB 1uF.

g.desc: C38: VBAT 100nF; C39: VDDA 10nF; C40: VDDUSB 1uF.

g.text: Place bypass capacitors close to their assigned MCU pins.

g.desc: Place bypass capacitors close to their assigned MCU pins.

g.text: NC GPIOs: PA1, PA7, PB2, PA15, PB4, PB5.

g.desc: NC GPIOs: PA1, PA7, PB2, PA15, PB4, PB5.

g.text: NT1: single PGND-GND copper connection directly beneath IC2 exposed pad.

g.desc: NT1: single PGND-GND copper connection directly beneath IC2 exposed pad.

g.text: EP/corner pads to GND, dense thermal vias; 4 layers / 2oz. Motor outputs: 5A routing.

g.desc: EP/corner pads to GND, dense thermal vias; 4 layers / 2oz. Motor outputs: 5A routing.

g.text: VM and +3V3_D supplied by power circuitry outside this specification.

g.desc: VM and +3V3_D supplied by power circuitry outside this specification.

g.text: USB only: MCU on, motor VM off.

g.desc: USB only: MCU on, motor VM off.

g.text: VM = ADC/4095 * VDDA * 19; wait >=10ms after power changes.

g.desc: VM = ADC/4095 * VDDA * 19; wait >=10ms after power changes.

g.text: 4.5A is driver absolute peak maximum; initial VREF limit ~1.97A/phase.

g.desc: 4.5A is driver absolute peak maximum; initial VREF limit ~1.97A/phase.

g.text: Route high-current PGND via NT1 only; keep BUCK_SW away from ADC.

g.desc: Route high-current PGND via NT1 only; keep BUCK_SW away from ADC.

g.text: AP2112 dissipation and motor/Q1 cooling require thermal validation.

g.desc: AP2112 dissipation and motor/Q1 cooling require thermal validation.

g.text: VM sense: 12-24V input, 1/19 divider, powered-off isolation.

g.desc: VM sense: 12-24V input, 1/19 divider, powered-off isolation.

g.text: Wait >=10ms after power switching; ADC sample >=247.5 cycles.

g.desc: Wait >=10ms after power switching; ADC sample >=247.5 cycles.

g.text: ADDR2 (PC13): R58 pulls low, default address bit 0.

g.desc: ADDR2 (PC13): R58 pulls low, default address bit 0.

g.text: BOOT0 uses existing boot switch/pulldown (PB8_BOOT net name is legacy).

g.desc: BOOT0 uses existing boot switch/pulldown (PB8_BOOT net name is legacy).

g.text: Use HSI/MSI internal clock for USB standalone startup.

g.desc: Use HSI/MSI internal clock for USB standalone startup.
